metadata.title: High-Contrast Red Light Portrait with Film Burn

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait characterized by intense red monochromatic lighting, heavy film grain, and vertical side-aligned typography.
triggerTerms: red light portrait with film burn
vertical side text with grainy red lighting
excludeWhen: clean minimalist vector art is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central portrait of a man with braided hair and a large chain, bathed in saturated red light against a deep black background, framed by vertical red film-burn light leaks on the left and right edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Saturated red highlights against absolute black shadows
Vertical text orientation mirroring the vertical light leaks
Rough film grain texture unifying the subject and background
Central subject placement with a downward gaze
coreInvariants: Monochromatic red-to-black color gradient on the subject
Vertical light leak borders on the left and right margins
Heavy digital or film grain overlay

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium close-up portrait, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The face and braided hair, highlighted by the most intense red light.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright hair, move down the face to the jewelry, then out to the vertical text on the left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space surrounds the subject, creating a claustrophobic, intense mood.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow-White (Hot spots in the film burn edges)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation in the reds with crushed blacks to maximize drama.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed within the left film burn area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all text elements to maintain a utilitarian, industrial look.

avoid: Horizontal placement for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, geometric, and impactful look of the vertical text.
Provides a similar industrial, sturdy feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with braids and a large chain, lit with intense red light from the side, against a black background. Add vertical red and yellow film burn light leaks on the left and right edges. Apply heavy film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical uppercase sans-serif text along the left edge, rotated 90 degrees, in black. Place a standard parental advisory logo at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting predominantly red and black?
Is the text oriented vertically on the left side?
Are there visible film burn effects on the margins?
Is the grain texture consistent across the image?

adjustableVariables: Width of the film burn borders
mustRedesign: Any horizontal text in the main title area
Bright colors other than red and yellow
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red light doesn't wash out facial features entirely.
Ensure the vertical text is legible against the light leak.
Verify the film grain doesn't look like digital noise.
Confirm the black background is deep and lacks detail.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast red-lit portrait with vertical side-aligned sans-serif typography and vintage film-burn border effects.
